title: metadata-admin: a ?tab=<sheet> deep link on a metadata item page never opens its sheet; the URL-sync effect deletes tab before the first-mount reader runs (ResourceEditPage)
body:
Filing gate ① · an out-of-scope finding of class a from objectui#12475's dev report (`6193317220`) · objectui `domain:ui` seat 2 · `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`. ⛔ Not a claim; for triage to grade and route.

reach: the console URL `?tab=audit`, `?tab=history`, `?tab=layers`, `?tab=references` or `?tab=related` on a metadata item page (`MetadataResourceEditPage`). These are the links the page itself writes so that a refresh or a shared link reopens the sheet. Measured with the real `MetadataResourceEditPage` in a vitest dom environment, not a browser: `window.location.search` read `?tab=audit` before mount, and the reader effect then saw an empty search.

## What the code does (`main` at `03cf7b2`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx`)

- `:1255`–`:1256`: an effect keeps the URL in sync with the open sheet. Its comment says this is "so deep-links round-trip": `if (openSheet) url.searchParams.set('tab', openSheet); else url.searchParams.delete('tab');`.
- `:1537`: a first-mount effect reads `sp.get('tab')` to open the sheet a link names.
- The sync effect is declared BEFORE the reader effect, so on mount it runs first with `openSheet === null` and deletes `tab`. The reader then sees no `tab`, so a deep link opens no sheet for any caller. Refreshing the page while a sheet is open loses it too.

## Ask

- A deep link `?tab=<sheet>` opens that sheet on mount, and the URL keeps `tab` afterwards: the round trip the comment promises. Reading the initial `tab` before the first sync, or seeding `openSheet` from it, would both do.
- Pins: mounting with `?tab=history` opens History and leaves `tab=history` in the URL. Closing the sheet removes `tab`.
- CONTROL: a caller the sheet is gated from (objectui#12475's `useCanReadAuthoringTrail`, `!createMode`) gets no sheet from a deep link.

Dedupe: search over objectui issues for "ResourceEditPage tab deep link" → 0.
